source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Wave-1 row 71 named the Quaternius Adventurer from the Animated Characters (24-clip rig) set on poly.pizza, now behind a Cloudflare challenge. Substituted with Cowboy_Male from the Quaternius Ultimate Animated Character Pack (Nov 2019) on OpenGameArt (same zip as man-casual). The pack has no adventurer or explorer; of its 50 characters the cowboy (wide-brimmed hat, neckerchief, vest over a shirt, mustache) is the closest outdoor-adventure character, ahead of Pirate_Male (nautical) and Worker_Male (row 77). It ships 11 clips (idle, walk, punch, hit, sit, pick-up, one-handed shoot, victory, defeat), not 24: no run, jump, death, sword or gun idles.
